name: app.joshlabs/volt
title: VOLT CEC 2024
description: Bilingual Canadian Electrical Code (CEC 2024) & Ontario 309A exam study guide across 1,946 lessons.

tools.name: get_system_manifest
tools.description: Get VOLT capabilities, CEC 2024 scope, free/Pro boundaries, Deep Link templates, and available tools.

tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Search all 1,946 CEC 2024 bilingual lessons by English term, Chinese keyword, section, or lesson ID.

query.description: Keyword, English term, Chinese phrase, section, or lesson ID (e.g. "GFCI", "015", "Section 2").

freeOnly.description: If true, only return free lessons (#001-#050).

tools.name: get_lesson_study_guide
tools.description: Fetch bilingual study guide and quiz for a lesson ID. Free for #001-#050; Pro Bearer token unlocks #051-#1946.

tools.name: get_quiz_sample
tools.description: Get free bilingual electrical practice questions (#001-#050) by topic keyword or lesson ID.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter free quiz topics.

includeAnswers.description: Include correct index and explanation (default false).

tools.name: get_my_progress
tools.description: Read authenticated student learning progress summary, accuracy, and weak sections. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: list_my_review_queue
tools.description: List authenticated student wrong-answer or bookmarked lessons with direct review deep links. Requires Bearer token.

tools.name: propose_study_action
tools.description: Submit a proposed bookmark list or study plan to the student inbox for 1-click confirmation inside VOLT. Cannot alter quiz scores. Requires Bearer token.

title.description: Short Chinese or English title (max 80 chars).

note.description: Optional reason or study advice (max 300 chars).
